description: A lightweight Fabric mod that adds datapack-defined crafting remainders, allowing custom recipes to return items to the crafting grid.

mods.name: Recipe Remainders
mods.description: Lets datapacks assign custom remainder items to individual ingredients in vanilla shaped and shapeless crafting recipes.

releases.notes:
Initialrelease for Minecraft 26.2.

### Added

- Custom crafting remainders for individual ingredients in shaped and shapeless recipes.
- Configured remainder stacks can include counts and components.
- Correct remainder placement for mirrored shaped recipes and overlapping shapeless ingredients.
- Unwrapped ingredients keep their vanilla remainders, while wrapped ingredients can override them for one recipe.
- Player crafting and vanilla crafter support.
- Recipe-book autofill checks full item components and skips invalid stacks.
- Fabric clients receive the full recipe data needed to display remainders immediately and make recipe-book checks account for item components.
- Server and client GameTests.
- Example datapacks covering the ingredient syntax and empty shulker-box uncrafting.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft `26.2`
- Fabric Loader `0.19.3` or a compatible newer version
- Fabric API `0.158.0+26.2` or newer for Minecraft 26.2
- Java `25`
